description: Replaces an argv-list subprocess.run() call with shell=True over an f-string that interpolates caller-controlled input_path/output_path unescaped.

findings.summary: Shell command injection via unescaped path interpolation with shell=True
findings.evidence: The safe argv-list form of subprocess.run([...], check=True) was replaced by subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, check=True) where cmd is an f-string splicing input_path/output_path directly; a path like '; rm -rf / #' or containing spaces/metacharacters executes arbitrary shell commands.
